questions.objective: Determine hunger regularity and digestive timing
questions.patient_text: How regular is your hunger during the day? (Agni)

options.label: Very regular — I feel hungry at exact fixed meal times
Irregular — Some days very hungry, other days no hunger at all
Very intense — Sharp hunger, get burning or headache if meal is delayed
Sluggish — Rarely feel hungry even after many hours

questions.objective: Assess post-meal abdominal symptoms and digestion time
questions.patient_text: How does your stomach usually feel after eating a normal meal? (Agni)

options.label: Comfortable and light after 2 to 3 hours
Heavy, sluggish, or feeling food remains in stomach for hours

questions.objective: Assess tolerance to heavy, oily, or cold food
questions.patient_text: How well do you digest heavy or fried meals? (Agni)

options.label: Tolerate well, but get hungry again quickly
Causes bloating, gas, or loose stools
Causes severe heaviness, nausea, or loss of appetite next day
